evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across six cooperative and competitive tasks, MASTraceBench tracks and grades proposal trajectories and provides a multi-layer metric suite covering Task Score, Collaboration Gain, proposal-trajectory indicators, and Token Cost.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
